name: proxy
description: Administer YOUR SMART on FHIR authorization proxy from the conversation. Bundles the smart-app-onboarding and smart-launch-debugging skills + the deployment's own MCP server, whose tools are generated from the admin API. Proxy Smart is self-hosted, so set PROXY_SMART_URL to your instance before installing. To try Proxy Smart without deploying one, install proxy-beta instead.

interface.displayName: Proxy Smart — SMART on FHIR administration
interface.shortDescription: Register and troubleshoot SMART apps on your own FHIR authorization proxy.
interface.longDescription: Proxy Smart sits between SMART apps and FHIR servers and handles OAuth 2.0 and SMART App Launch 2.2.0. This plugin connects an assistant to a deployment's admin API over MCP, so registering an app, choosing its scopes and launch type, wiring FHIR server access and Keycloak Organizations, and working out why a launch or token failed all happen in the conversation instead of the console. The deployment is yours: set PROXY_SMART_URL to your instance. To explore Proxy Smart without deploying one, install proxy-beta, which is pinned to the public demo environment.
